leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Apply TypeScript generics to define event handler functions with proper typing
Use React event types like React.ChangeEvent and React.MouseEvent to type event parameters
Implement form submission handlers with typed event parameters to prevent default behavior
Execute conditional logic based on event properties like event.target.value with type safety
Utilize union types to handle multiple event types in a single handler function
Construct custom event handler interfaces to define specific event requirements
Define typed state update functions that respond to specific event types
Access event properties like currentTarget and target with proper TypeScript typing
Control form input values by connecting onChange events to typed state variables
Modify event handler signatures to accept specific HTML element types for precise typing
Invoke event.preventDefault() within typed event handlers to manage form submissions
Assign appropriate event types to onClick, onChange, and onSubmit handlers in JSX
